# Recipe Images

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The photo or image assets associated with a recipe.

## Scope note

Recipe photography used in detail/list views (including the rating and carb overlays); distinct from RecipeSource.

## Broader

- [Recipe](../Recipe/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
